content: {"praised":["Romero’s direction brings thunder to the zombie genre.","The film’s concept of a film within a film is executed well.","It’s considered one of the finest zombie movies out there.","The movie’s tone and themes resonate with horror fans.","The visuals and music enhance the overall atmosphere."],"criticized":["Acting is subpar and lacks depth.","Dialogue feels clunky and poorly written.","The film attempts a Cloverfield/Blair Witch vibe poorly.","Viewers feel the movie doesn’t bring them joy.","The pacing and story fail to engage some audiences."]}
